title: Isla
intro_text:
It is a quarter to four on a Thursday in November, gray and cold. You have just ridden through the last of the school traffic.

You are Isla. You are a child psychologist at Willow House, a children's counseling center in an old brick house on a corner. At four you will meet a six-year-old named Wren. It will be your third time.

You chain the bike to the porch rail and unclip the canvas bag. Behind the green door, a lamp is already on.
